mapper.sql: m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.route_name, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon
mapper.select: select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.del_flag = '0' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.menu_id

select distinct from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and ( exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_menu` um where um.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and um.member_id = #{merchantId} and um.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and um.menu_id = m.menu_id) or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` rm on rm.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and rm.member_id = ur.member_id and rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and rm.menu_id = m.menu_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0') ) order by m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.menu_id
select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.menu_id = #{menuId} and m.del_flag = '0'

select m.menu_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` rm on rm.menu_id = m.menu_id where rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and rm.member_id = #{merchantId} and rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.del_flag = '0'
and m.menu_id not in ( select child.parent_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` child inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` child_rm on child_rm.menu_id = child.menu_id where child_rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and child_rm.member_id = #{merchantId} and child_rm.role_id = #{roleId} and child.tenant_id = 0 and child.member_id = 0 and child.del_flag = '0')
order by m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.menu_id

select count(1) from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` where tenant_id = 0 and member_id = 0 and del_flag = '0' and (perms is null or perms = '' or perms like 'merchant:%') and menu_id in #{menuId}
